preset.name: vc17win64-gpu-md
preset.comment: VC17 Win64 PhysX general settings (GPU, dynamic CRT)

cmakeSwitch.name: PX_GENERATE_GPU_PROJECTS_ONLY
cmakeSwitch.comment: Generate both CPU and GPU projects

cmakeSwitch.name: PX_GENERATE_GPU_REDUCED_ARCHITECTURES
cmakeSwitch.comment: Generate a single CUDA arch + PTX fallback. Required on GitHub runners (16 GB RAM) — the full arch set OOM-crashes ptxas with -t0 parallel nvcc. PTX JIT covers any sm_70+ GPU at first run.

cmakeSwitch.name: NV_USE_STATIC_WINCRT
cmakeSwitch.comment: Use the dynamically linked Windows CRT

cmakeSwitch.name: NV_USE_DEBUG_WINCRT
cmakeSwitch.comment: Use the debug version of the CRT for debug builds

cmakeParam.name: CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX
cmakeParam.comment: Install path relative to PhysX SDK root
